svg.desc: RuleSync authorization architecture. Stage 2 and the A inset reuse the same six-point candidate P. Snapshot M and admission inset reuse the same seven-vertex keep-out polygon by uniform scaling. Full authorization A has an explicit rightward RuleGuard input arrow.
